goal: Get `python visualization.py --mem_path <path to bedroom_01.pkl> --clip_id 1` working in /work/m3-agent. Download the pre-built memory graph from the public HF dataset ByteDance-Seed/M3-Bench (memory_graphs/robot.tar.gz, 2.4 GB) and extract bedroom_01.pkl. Install only the dependencies needed; do not download the large models or run GPU steps. configs/api_config.json has empty values, and importing mmagent may fail on them, so you may need dummy values; no real API key is required. The script must print the memory of clip 1 (episodic/semantic nodes, faces, voices).
